missions.name: Sentinel-Optima: High-Res Biosphere & Thermal Early Warning
missions.description: Deploy a multi-spectral optical and thermal infrared pushbroom imager to map global boreal wildfire fronts and deforested boundaries.
scientific_objectives: Achieve < 15m Ground Sample Distance (GSD)
Downlink at least 450 GB of multispectral raw imagery
Maintain continuous thermal telemetry within -15°C to +35°C
failure_conditions: Mass exceeds launcher capacity
Battery DoD exceeds 60% during 35-min eclipse

missions.name: Aether-Link: High-Throughput Ka-Band Relay Constellation
missions.description: Establish a wideband geostationary telecommunications node providing uninterrupted telemetry relay for polar and low-Earth science fleets.
scientific_objectives: Sustain 99.99% communications availability over Pacific & Atlantic gateways
Continuous multi-gigabit routing using phased-array transceivers
failure_conditions: Pointing error > 0.05°
Propellant depletion before GEO circularization

missions.name: Baro-Storm: Atmospheric Radar & Cyclogenesis Profiler
missions.description: Track Category 5 tropical cyclones, tropospheric water vapor transport, and Antarctic katabatic wind vectors using L-band radar profiling.
scientific_objectives: Capture vertical cloud reflectivity profiles through storm eyewalls
Transmit 24/7 real-time meteorological weather feeds to NOAA/EUMETSAT
failure_conditions: Radar antenna deployment mechanism jam
Structural fatigue in thermal cycling

missions.name: Artemis Herald: Polar Cold-Trap Volatile Mapper
missions.description: Survey the lunar South Pole (Shackleton, Faustini, Shoemaker craters) for water-ice concentrations in permanently shadowed regions (PSR).
scientific_objectives: Sub-surface hydrogen neutron/radar profiling of polar cold traps
Laser altimetry mapping of peaks of eternal light for future solar bases
failure_conditions: Lunar gravitational mass concentrations (mascons) destabilize orbit without RCS trim

missions.name: Selene Touchdown: Malapert Mountain Precision Landing
missions.description: Execute autonomous powered descent and soft touchdown on the rim ridge of Malapert Mountain with hazard avoidance radar.
scientific_objectives: Perform soft landing with touchdown vertical velocity < 1.5 m/s
Operate stationary seismometer and regolith heat-probe package
missions.communication_requirement: Lunar Relay Orbiter or direct DSN link
failure_conditions: Touchdown velocity exceeds leg structural limit (> 2.5 m/s)
Landing on > 15° slope

missions.name: Peregrine Trek: Shackleton Crater Interior Rover Expedition
missions.description: Deploy an autonomous mobile surface rover into the pitch-black cryogenic interior of Shackleton crater (-240°C) using RTG heating.
scientific_objectives: Traverse at least 5.0 km across rugged polar boulder fields
Core drill 1.0m into cryo-regolith to sample pure volatile water ice
failure_conditions: Rover battery freeze in permanently shadowed region
Wheel entrapment in soft electrostatic dust

missions.name: Chang'e-Pro: South Pole Regolith Cryogenic Return
missions.description: Collect 2.0 kg of pristine cryogenic volatiles from the lunar south pole, launch lunar ascent stage, and guide heat-shielded return capsule to Earth.
scientific_objectives: Hermetically seal cryogenic volatile ice core sample at < -150°C
Survive hypervelocity atmospheric re-entry at 11.2 km/s into Utah Salt Flats
missions.communication_requirement: DSN 70m Goldstone / Madrid Deep Space tracking
failure_conditions: Ascent stage ignition failure
Parachute deployment pyro jam on Earth return

missions.name: Ares Observer: Trace Gas & Methane Plume Spectrometry
missions.description: Perform Mars Orbit Insertion (MOI) and aerobraking to map seasonal methane outgassing and sub-surface glacial ice deposits.
scientific_objectives: Perform Trans-Mars Injection (TMI) with 4.3 km/s total Delta-V
Atmospheric occultation spectrometry profiling parts-per-billion atmospheric trace gases
missions.communication_requirement: DSN 34m dishes (One-way light time: 4 to 21 min)
failure_conditions: Overheating during aerobraking pass in upper Martian atmosphere
Sun-Earth-Mars solar conjunction blackout

missions.name: Red Planet Seismology: Cerberus Fossae Seismic Observatory
missions.description: Survive hypersonic atmospheric entry with aeroshell heat shield, deploy supersonic parachute, and retro-rocket touchdown in Cerberus Fossae.
scientific_objectives: Deploy ultra-sensitive broadband seismometer onto Martian bedrock
Detect Marsquakes and measure crustal thickness down to the Martian core
missions.communication_requirement: UHF relay via Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter
failure_conditions: Heat shield breach during 5.8 km/s hypersonic entry
Radar altimeter lockout over boulder terrain

missions.name: Prometheus: Jezero Delta Astrobiology Rover
missions.description: Utilize a rocket-powered skycrane descent stage to lower a heavy nuclear-powered rover directly into Jezero ancient lake delta.
scientific_objectives: Raman & UV luminescence scan of delta mudstones for ancient fossilized microbial biosignatures
Collect and seal 15 rock core sample tubes in sterile titanium canisters
missions.communication_requirement: Direct X-Band High-Gain Dish + UHF Orbiter Relay
failure_conditions: Skycrane umbilical tether release failure
Dust accumulation blinding optical navigation cameras

missions.name: Lucy-Pathfinder: Trojan Asteroid Multi-Target Reconnaissance
missions.description: Fly past four Jupiter Trojan asteroids sharing Jupiter's orbit (L4 and L5 swarm) to examine primordial outer solar system composition.
scientific_objectives: Perform high-speed imaging at closest approach (< 1,000 km)
Measure crater size distributions and volatile organic surface coating
failure_conditions: Attitude slew rate too slow during 12 km/s flyby passage

missions.name: Psyche Metal World: 16-Psyche Nickel-Iron Orbital Insertion
missions.description: Rendezvous with and orbit 16-Psyche, an exposed metallic planetary core in the outer asteroid belt, utilizing Hall-effect ion propulsion.
scientific_objectives: Determine if 16-Psyche is an intact metallic core of an early protoplanet
Map surface magnetic fields and nickel-iron elemental distribution
failure_conditions: Ion engine grid sputtering erosion before reaching target
Chaotic non-spherical gravity field escape

missions.name: Osiris-Chronos: Carbonaceous Chondrite Touch-And-Go (TAG)
missions.description: Perform Touch-and-Go sampling on a ruble-pile carbonaceous asteroid, inject pressurized nitrogen to collect 250g of pristine organic dust, and return to Earth.
scientific_objectives: Secure at least 150 grams of pristine pre-solar organic compounds
Execute direct atmospheric re-entry capsule landing in Utah
failure_conditions: Spacecraft sinks into fluid-like asteroid surface regolith
Capsule drogue parachute fails during re-entry

missions.name: Jovian Sovereign: Deep Atmosphere Probe & Magnetosphere Survey
missions.description: Navigate devastating Jovian radiation belts by skimming within 4,000 km of cloud tops to probe deep water abundances and core dynamo convection.
scientific_objectives: Survive cumulative 100 krad radiation dose inside 1cm titanium radiation vault
Map Jovian magnetic field harmonics to degree 30
failure_conditions: Total ionizing dose (TID) kills non-shielded microprocessors
Solar concentrator array tracking slip in deep space

missions.name: Europa Deep-Scout: Ice Penetrating Radar & Plume Sampling
missions.description: Fly through active water vapor plumes erupting from Europa's fractured ice shell, using ice-penetrating radar to measure ice shell thickness.
scientific_objectives: Determine depth to liquid water ocean (radar sound 10 to 30 km ice crust)
Direct mass spectrometer ingestion of plume ice crystals searching for organic peptides
failure_conditions: Radiation induced latch-up in instrument sensor front-end
Failure of radar dipole antenna boom deployment

missions.name: Kronos Horizon: Ring Particle Dynamics & Hexagon Weather
missions.description: Investigate Saturn's persistent northern polar atmospheric hexagon and fly between the inner D ring and upper atmosphere.
scientific_objectives: Measure ring mass and ring rain rate into Saturn's ionosphere
Direct thermal infrared mapping of polar vortex winds
failure_conditions: High-velocity ring particle impact shattering radiator
Ion propulsion power starvation beyond 9.5 AU

missions.name: Titan Last Transmission: Hydrocarbon Sea Aerobot Probe
missions.description: Enter Titan's dense nitrogen atmosphere, jettison heatshield, deploy dual-rotor aerial quadcopter, and sample shoreline muds of Kraken Mare at -179°C.
scientific_objectives: Survive high-Mach atmospheric entry and glide across liquid methane seas
Perform in-situ mass spectrometry on organic tholins and prebiotic amino acid precursors
Transmit surface telemetry through nitrogen haze back to DSN relay
failure_conditions: Atmospheric icing / frozen methane build-up on rotor blades
Cryogenic thermal seal failure at -179°C

missions.name: Webb-Pro: Sun-Earth L2 Gravitational Wave & Exoplanet Transit
missions.target_orbit: Sun-Earth Lagrange L2 Halo Orbit (1.5M km from Earth)
missions.description: Deploy a 5-layer Kapton sunshield cooled cryogenic space observatory at Sun-Earth L2 to characterize habitable exoplanet atmospheres via transmission spectroscopy.
scientific_objectives: Maintain instrument detectors at stable 7 Kelvin using closed-cycle cryocooler
Detect atmospheric biosignatures (O2, O3, CH4, CO2) in Earth-sized exoplanet transits
missions.communication_requirement: Continuous L2 Halo Orbit DSN passes
failure_conditions: Sunshield tear or deployment mechanism jam
Reaction wheel bearing degradation causing pointing jitter

missions.name: Orbital Fuel Depot: Cryogenic LOX/Methane Autonomous Refueler
missions.description: Establish an automated orbital refueling node with zero-boil-off active cryocooling to transfer 20 metric tons of propellants to outbound deep-space ships.
scientific_objectives: Zero-boil-off cryogenic propellant storage over 1 year orbital duration
Autonomous optical rendezvous and docking with sub-centimeter alignment
failure_conditions: Cryogenic boil-off pressure spike rupturing tank rupture disk
Docking mechanism kinetic collision

missions.name: Solar Swarm: Multi-Spacecraft Interplanetary Radio Interferometer
missions.description: A 4-spacecraft collaborative fleet operating in synchronized formation across 100,000 km baselines to form a synthetic aperture radio telescope imaging black hole accretion disks.
scientific_objectives: Nanosecond atomic clock synchronization across 4 independent flight craft
Synthesize virtual 100,000 km radio aperture resolving sub-millisecond arcsecond structures
Multi-player coordinated flight operations between all 4 agency specialists
failure_conditions: Loss of phase synchronization between any 2 spacecraft
Formation drift exceeding inter-satellite laser acquisition cone

missions.name: RadarSat-X: Cloud-Penetrating Interferometric SAR Disaster Monitor
missions.description: Deploy an L-band synthetic aperture radar with phased-array antenna to monitor tectonic strain, flood inundation, and ice sheet velocity through 100% cloud cover.
scientific_objectives: Millimeter-level surface deformation detection via InSAR interferometry
Generate 50m resolution global soil moisture and flood hazard maps
Maintain radar pulse phase coherence over 5-year mission duration
failure_conditions: Antenna deployment hinge latch failure
Power bus voltage sag during radar transmit pulses

missions.name: AeroCom-Alpha: High-Throughput Ka-Band Geostationary Telecom Hub
missions.description: Position a high-throughput multi-spotbeam communications satellite in GEO slot 102.5°W to deliver 100 Gbps total throughput to airborne and maritime mobile terminals.
scientific_objectives: Maintain north-south and east-west stationkeeping within +/-0.05 degrees
Sustain 15-year operational lifetime in Van Allen outer radiation belt
Power 48 active Ka-band traveling wave tube amplifiers during equinox eclipses
missions.communication_requirement: Dual High-Gain Ka-band Multi-beam Gateway Links
failure_conditions: Arc-discharge breakdown in high-voltage traveling wave tubes
Stationkeeping propellant depletion prior to 12 years

missions.name: AstroSweeper: Autonomous Active Orbital Debris Harpoon & De-orbit
missions.description: Execute autonomous optical rendezvous and capture of a spent 1.2-ton upper stage rocket body using a robotic clamp mechanism and controlled destructive de-orbit burn into Point Nemo.
scientific_objectives: Autonomous non-cooperative target relative navigation to within 0.5 meters
Execute physical docking clamp latch on non-stabilized tumbling cylinder
Deliver 180 m/s delta-v de-orbit burn targeting safe Pacific Ocean disposal
missions.communication_requirement: S-Band Telemetry & Tracking via Ground Station Network
failure_conditions: Robotic capture collision causing fragmentation cascading
De-orbit impact footprint deviation into populated zones

missions.name: Cygnus-Prime: Autonomous Pressurized Cargo Resupply to Orbital Station
missions.description: Launch an automated pressurized cargo carrier transporting 2,500 kg of scientific experiments, water, and replacement components to the international orbital research laboratory.
scientific_objectives: Precision orbital phasing and rendezvous within Keep-Out Sphere
Autonomous soft-berthing to Common Berthing Mechanism (CBM) port
Hold 28-day berthed quiescent operations supporting onboard microgravity research
missions.communication_requirement: Continuous TDRS Space Relay with Video Telemetry
failure_conditions: Trajectory drift inside station approach corridor
Pressure hull micrometeoroid penetration

missions.name: VIPER-Next: Permanently Shadowed Volatile Neutron Prospecting Rover
missions.target_orbit: Lunar South Pole Surface (89.5°S, Nobile Crater Rim)
missions.description: Deploy a 4-wheel drive semi-autonomous lunar rover equipped with a 1-meter regolith auger drill and neutron spectrometer into freezing (-240°C) permanently shadowed craters.
scientific_objectives: Traverse at least 20 km over rough lunar cryogenic regolith terrain
Detect hydrogen concentrations down to 100 ppm using neutron spectrometer
Extract 12 subsurface ice-regolith core samples at 1m depth
failure_conditions: Wheel immobilization in soft volatile dust traps
Battery temperature dropping below -40°C in shadow

missions.name: Artemis-Net: Far-Side Lunar Halo Orbit Optical/RF Communications Gateway
missions.target_orbit: Earth-Moon L2 Southern Halo Orbit (Z-amplitude 14,000 km)
missions.description: Insert a dedicated communications relay satellite into an Earth-Moon L2 halo orbit to provide unbroken line-of-sight telemetry between Earth and far-side lunar surface landers.
scientific_objectives: Maintain halo orbit stationkeeping using ultra-low delta-v (< 15 m/s/year)
Provide 100% geometric visibility to lunar far-side and South Pole landing sites
Downlink high-bandwidth lunar science data to Goldstone and Madrid DSN antennas
missions.communication_requirement: High-Power Ka-Band Relay + Deep Space Optical Link
failure_conditions: Halo orbit insertion delta-v pointing error exceeding 0.2 deg
Transponder lock loss during solar transit

missions.name: Chang'e-Legacy: South Pole-Aitken Deep Subsurface Core Sample Return
missions.target_orbit: Lunar Orbit (100 km) + Surface Landing + Earth Return
missions.description: A complex 4-module mission (Orbiter, Lander, Ascent Vehicle, Earth Re-entry Capsule) to drill 2 meters into the South Pole-Aitken Basin mantle rocks and return 2.0 kg to Earth.
scientific_objectives: Autonomous hazard avoidance landing in boulder-strewn impact crater
Drill and hermetically seal 2.0 kg of pristine lunar mantle regolith
Ascent vehicle orbital launch and autonomous docking with return orbiter in lunar orbit
Hyperbolic Earth atmospheric entry at 11.2 km/s with intact parachute touchdown
missions.communication_requirement: Lunar Relay Cross-Link + Earth DSN Direct
failure_conditions: Ascent stage rendezvous failure in 100km lunar orbit
Sample return heatshield ablation breach during Earth entry

missions.name: Altair-Architect: Two-Stage Human Landing System Descent-Ascent Stage
missions.description: Design and validate the descent stage for a reusable crewed lunar lander capable of landing 4 astronauts at the Lunar South Pole with 7 days of surface life support.
scientific_objectives: Execute deep-throttling LOX/Methane descent burn with zero-velocity touchdown
Support 4-person crew life support consumables and power for 168 hours surface stay
Demonstrate automated ascent stage propellant chill-down and readiness
missions.communication_requirement: Multi-channel High-Definition Video & Telemetry to DSN
failure_conditions: Descent engine gimbal actuator stall during final pitch-up
Landing leg crushable honeycomb rupture exceeding slope limit

missions.name: Ares-Shield: Direct Atmospheric Aerocapture & Thermal Tile Validation
missions.target_orbit: Hyperbolic Entry -> Aerocapture -> Low Mars Orbit (300 km)
missions.description: Pioneer flight-proven aerocapture at Mars by utilizing a rigid aeroshell lifting body to brake into elliptical orbit in a single atmospheric pass, saving 1,200 kg of propellant.
scientific_objectives: Guidance, navigation, and control through Mars upper atmosphere corridor (45-60 km)
Measure convective and radiative heat flux on carbon-phenolic TPS
Apoapsis raise burn at first orbit exit to circularize at 300 km
failure_conditions: Atmospheric exit trajectory undershoot resulting in surface impact
Lift-vector roll error causing planetary skip-out into solar orbit

missions.name: MARSIS-2: Subsurface Low-Frequency Radar Water Ice Aquifer Sounder
missions.target_orbit: Elliptical Polar Mars Orbit (250 x 800 km, 86°)
missions.description: Deploy a 40-meter dipole radar sounder operating at 1.8-5.0 MHz to penetrate through the Martian south polar layered deposits and detect liquid briny subglacial lakes at 1.5 km depth.
scientific_objectives: Map dielectric contrast of polar ice cap basal boundary across both hemispheres
Detect subsurface liquid brine aquifers with > 95% confidence interval
Generate 3D radar echogram atlas of Medusae Fossae porous dust formations
missions.communication_requirement: X-Band Deep Space Downlink (>= 120 kbps at 2.5 AU)
failure_conditions: 40m radar dipole antenna boom deployment jam
Severe ionospheric plasma dispersion blinding radar reception

missions.name: Phobos-Grit: Low-Gravity Touch-and-Go Regolith Core Return
missions.target_orbit: Phobos Quasi-Satellite Orbit (QSO) + Touchdown + Earth Return
missions.description: Fly to Mars moon Phobos, enter close formation orbit, touch down in microgravity (0.0057 m/s²) using cold-gas anchoring thrusters, collect 100g of regolith, and return it to Earth.
scientific_objectives: Proximity formation flight in non-spherical irregular gravity field
Touch-and-go sampling arm deployment within 3-second contact window
Determine whether Phobos is a captured D-type asteroid or giant impact ejecta
missions.communication_requirement: DSN X-Band Deep Space Network Tracking
failure_conditions: Spacecraft rebound velocity exceeding Phobos escape velocity during touch
Earth atmospheric entry capsule thermal seal contamination

missions.name: Prometheus-Oxygen: Sabatier CO2 Electrolysis & MAV Propellant Generator
missions.description: Land a heavy industrial payload on Mars that ingests atmospheric carbon dioxide and produces 5.0 metric tons of liquid oxygen (LOX) using high-temperature solid oxide electrolysis.
scientific_objectives: Extract 98% pure oxygen from 6 mbar atmospheric CO2 at 2.5 kg/hour rate
Cryo-liquefy and store liquid oxygen at 90 K for 500 sols with < 0.1% boil-off
Demonstrate autonomous launch vehicle tank refuelling umbilical connection
missions.communication_requirement: Mars Relay Orbiter UHF Proximity Link + Direct X-Band
failure_conditions: Solid oxide electrolysis ceramic cell thermal shock fracture
Compressor seal fouling from abrasive airborne Martian dust

missions.name: Chondrite-Core: 16 Psyche Metal Asteroid Gravity & Magnetic Field Mapper
missions.target_orbit: Solar Electric Cruise -> Psyche Orbit B1/B2 (100 km)
missions.description: Rendezvous with metallic asteroid 16 Psyche in the outer asteroid belt using xenon ion thrusters. Measure remanent magnetic crustal fields to prove it was once an active planetary dynamo.
scientific_objectives: Confirm metallic nickel-iron surface composition via multispectral gamma/neutron spec
Map remnant paleomagnetic dipole signatures frozen in metallic rocks
Determine density distribution and bulk porosity through radio science tracking
failure_conditions: Ion engine grid erosion failure during 3-year cruise
Spacecraft charging anomaly near highly conductive metallic asteroid

missions.name: RheaSilvia: Basaltic Lava Crust & Deep Impact Crater Stratigraphy
missions.description: Orbit differentiated asteroid 4 Vesta to map the immense Rheasilvia impact crater central peak (22 km high) and measure isotopic ratios matching Howardite-Eucrite-Diogenite meteorites.
scientific_objectives: High-resolution stereo elevation mapping of equatorial graben canyons
Visible and infrared mineralogical identification of pyroxene basalt flows
Detect volatile hydroxyl signatures in shadowed polar crater floors
failure_conditions: Reaction wheel desaturation fuel depletion
Solar array output degradation below 2.4 AU threshold

missions.name: Aegis-Impactor: Hypervelocity Kinetic Deflection of Dimorphos Moonlet
missions.description: Execute a planetary defence kinetic impactor test by slamming a 600 kg spacecraft at 6.6 km/s into the center-of-mass of asteroid moonlet Dimorphos to alter its binary orbital period.
scientific_objectives: Autonomous SMART Nav optical terminal guidance in final 4 hours of flight
Impact binary asteroid moonlet within 15 meters of target center
Transmit real-time 1 Hz stream of impact crater boulders down to 1 second before impact
failure_conditions: Autonomous terminal optical navigation tracking loss on asteroid moonlet
Thruster latch valve failure preventing terminal trajectory corrections

missions.name: Valhalla-Base: Callisto Low-Radiation Staging Orbit & Ice Crust Sounding
missions.target_orbit: Jupiter Polar Capture -> Callisto Circular Orbit (150 km)
missions.description: Enter orbit around Callisto, Jupiter's outermost Galilean moon, taking advantage of its mild radiation environment (0.01 mSv/day) to survey pristine ancient ice and map the giant Valhalla multiring crater.
scientific_objectives: Radar sound the upper 5 km of Callisto's ancient impact-saturated ice crust
Measure induced magnetic dipole to confirm a deep, conductive subsurface ocean
Establish orbital telecommunications relay architecture for future human crewed outposts
failure_conditions: Jupiter gravity-assist pitch error throwing trajectory into radiation belt
Deep cryogenic freezing of hydrazine propellant lines

missions.name: CryoGeyser: Low-Altitude Enceladus Tiger Stripe Plume Sampling Probe
missions.target_orbit: Saturn Orbit -> Enceladus Close Flybys (25 km altitude)
missions.description: Fly through the supersonic water-ice and organic molecule geysers erupting from the South Pole of Enceladus at 25 km altitude, sampling prebiotic amino acids without needing to land.
scientific_objectives: Capture intact ice grains with aerogel collector without thermal destruction
Gas chromatograph mass spec detection of complex macromolecules (mass > 200 Da)
Measure molecular hydrogen (H2) and methane concentrations indicative of methanogenesis
failure_conditions: Spacecraft disorientation from supersonic plume dynamic pressure
Ice grain impact erosion of optical sensors during 25km pass

missions.name: Cronus-Deep: Hypervelocity Saturn Deep Atmospheric Pressure Sink Probe
missions.description: Release a heavily shielded planetary entry probe into Saturn's cloud decks to descend to 20 bars pressure, measuring noble gas abundances (helium, neon, argon) and lightning discharges.
scientific_objectives: Survive peak aerothermal deceleration exceeding 250 g's with carbon-phenolic heatshield
Direct in-situ mass spectrometer sampling of atmospheric layers down to 20 bar
Relay data in real-time to carrier flyby bus before thermal crushing

failure_conditions: Parachute mortar deployment timer malfunction
Carrier bus loses line-of-sight geometry before probe reaches 15 bar depth

missions.name: Titania-Pathfinder: Uranus System Orbiter & Methane Cloud Penetrator
missions.target_orbit: Uranus System Polar Capture (19.2 AU distance)
missions.description: A 12-year flagship expedition using an RTG-powered orbiter and atmospheric probe to investigate the icy core structure, anomalous 98° tilt, and fractured moons (Miranda, Titania) of Uranus.
scientific_objectives: Map complex tilted, offset magnetic dipole dynamo using fluxgate magnetometers
Drop atmospheric entry probe to measure methane cloud deck condensation depth
High-resolution imaging of Miranda's 20-km vertical Verona Chasma cliffs
missions.communication_requirement: Ka-Band 34m/70m Deep Space Network Dish Array
failure_conditions: RTG thermocouple output degradation over 12-year cruise
Orbit insertion burn telemetry failure due to 2.5-hour one-way light delay

missions.name: Nereid-Horizon: Neptune Ice Giant & Triton Cryo-Geyser Dual Encounter
missions.target_orbit: Neptune Aerocapture / Elliptical Orbit + Triton Resonant Flybys
missions.description: Voyage to the edge of the major planets (30 AU) to orbit Neptune and repeatedly encounter Triton, measuring its cantaloupe terrain, active nitrogen geysers, and retrograde orbital decay.
scientific_objectives: Confirm active nitrogen cryovolcanic eruption mechanics in -235°C exosphere
Determine internal heat budget driving Triton's geysers using infrared radiometer
Measure wind speed and vorticity of Neptune's Great Dark Spot vortex storms
missions.communication_requirement: Ultra-sensitive 70-meter DSN Ka-Band Uplink (4.1-hour light delay)

Optical sensor blind-spot during retrograde hypervelocity flyby

missions.name: L2-ExoSearch: Sun-Earth L2 Coronagraphic Habitable World Biosignature Array
missions.target_orbit: Sun-Earth L2 Lagrange Halo Orbit (1.5 Million km)
missions.description: Deploy a 6-meter segmented space telescope equipped with an extreme starlight coronagraph to directly image Earth-sized rocky exoplanets in nearby star habitable zones and search for atmospheric oxygen and methane biosignatures.
scientific_objectives: Starlight suppression ratio of 10^-10 using adaptive optics coronagraph mask
Direct spectroscopic detection of H2O, O2, O3, and CH4 in exoplanet atmospheres
Picometer-level wavefront stability at 35 Kelvin passive cryo-thermal equilibrium

Reaction wheel micro-vibration exceeding picometer pointing tolerance

missions.name: Voyager-Continuum: Radioisotope Heliopause Crossing at 200 AU
missions.target_orbit: Solar Gravity Assist -> Interstellar Hyperbolic Escape (7.5 AU/year)
missions.description: Launch a next-generation interstellar probe powered by dual Pu-238 RTGs that executes a close perihelion Oberth maneuver around the Sun to reach 200 AU within 25 years, directly sampling pristine galactic cosmic rays and interstellar magnetic fields outside the heliosphere.

Demonstrate optical laser communications across 200 AU (27.7-hour light time)
